name: tool-weaver
description: Autonomous tool generator. Takes a tool specification (name, description, params, logic code), scaffolds tool.py + tool.json, validates syntax, installs to memory/tools/, and registers in registry/init/graph. Like Voyager's skill codex but for Python.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 'generate' to create a new tool, 'patch' to update an existing tool

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Tool specification JSON. See --help for schema.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Creation result with paths, validation status, registry update
